title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-02-14
runtime: material (see info files); hosted by gdlive.com

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stellar February run, highlighted by a flawless full‑Anthem of the Sun second set and tight first‑set jams.
ai_review.review: The recording (a soundboard source) is praised for its crystal‑clear mix and superb balance, with only a brief patch needed in the Alligator jam. Musically the show is described as one of the best of the February ’68 run – a tight first set featuring Dark Star → China Cat → The Eleven → Turn on Your Lovelight, followed by an almost verbatim performance of the Anthem of the Sun album and a soaring Spanish Jam, all linked by seamless transitions.

ai_rating.rationale: The detailed 5‑star review highlights an outstanding performance and excellent soundboard quality; the only other comment is neutral, so rating reflects a high‑quality show with excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean mix with superb balance; minor patch needed for a cut in the Alligator jam but otherwise flawless.

standout_songs: Anthem of the Sun (full album sequence)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth, flawless transitions throughout both sets; the second set mirrors the Anthem of the Sun album and maintains a high energy level.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as 'in the zone' with perfect tone; leads seamless segues and delivers expressive rhythm licks.
band_member_comments.Phil: His organ drives The Eleven; praised for artful improvisation after vocals on New Potato and solo moments.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s keyboards lay groundwork for jams; vocal on Alligator noted as a bit low but the jam remains fabulous.
